exit_criteria.text: Demonstrate the missing durable overview through real composition and a failing-before assertion.
Persist only validated accepted overview evidence under exact profile revision, host authority, account, repository and PR identity with bounded storage and exact revision content.
Admit cached metadata only for a current authenticated read that failed for transport loss; refuse cancellation, stale session, foreign authority and corrupt data; reconnect to server truth.
Verify rendered cached/unavailable wording, owning-layer negative controls and actual process restart; record exact candidate, pending full AC2/AC3, command quiescence and writer release.
Demonstrate missing durable file catalogue through the real restart composition and a failing-before assertion.

Retain exact current and previous paths, provider change kinds and counts with complete overview authority and revisions; distinguish unavailable from observed empty and bound optional content without truncation.
Verify account/repository/profile/revision isolation, cancellation and stale session refusal, corrupt and legacy records, and reconnect server truth through focused public and owning-layer controls.
Record exact candidate, rendered read-only catalogue evidence, pending source/conversations and full AC2/AC3, command quiescence and writer release.
